text:
maria: Heads up — after last night's kernel-selector tweak (canary 3 -> 4) I'm seeing 95p TTFT on /chat-route jump ~12% for prompts ~1.2k tokens. Dashboard: https://redwood.monitor/r/xyz :grimacing:

deepak: Ugh. Any interesting slices? seq len, kv-hit, or batch size?

maria: Early look: spike coincides with larger seqs + KV miss rate up. 50-60% of affected requests hit the 'fallback->microkernel' path.
aaron: Pasted profiler for an example request (seq 1248):
```
TTFT  210ms
 - queue  18ms
 - prefetch/KV  86ms  (misses + prefetch delay)
 - kernel selection  6ms
 - microkernel decode 100ms
```

sophie: deploy-bot shows canary rollout at 02:11 UTC last night: deploy-bot: canary 4 -> 25% at 02:11, 100% at 02:46.

maria: I think the heuristic change widened the microkernel eligibility window (we now prefer microkernel for sequences >1024 when batch_size < 4). For these routes batch_size distribution is skewed low at night.
deepak: That matches. Old heuristic favored tiled-kernel for long seqs if kv-hit rate > 0.7; new one skipped kv-hit gating. So if kv missed we go microkernel and prefetch cost + slow decode = regression.
aaron: Quick repro command I used: `RUNDIR=canary4 ./benchmark --route /chat-route --seq 1248 --p75` — reproducible locally. Also saw trace id abc123 with detailed spans.
sophie: KV cache logs: around regression window we saw 3x increase in KVCACHE_MISS for that route. Possibly prefetch race with shard eviction.
maria: Action suggestions:
  * add direct span for "kernel-decision-latency" (ms) — to attribute TTFT portion to selection vs prefetch. (owner: deepak)
  * emit tag on request when decision leads to fallback microkernel (owner: aaron)
  * add heatmap on dashboard: (seq_len vs batch_size) color by p95 TTFT (owner: maria)

deepak: I'll add the kernel-decision span to the trace lib and a short metric kernel_decision_ms (histogram). Will also instrument boolean tag `decision=fallback_microkernel`. ETA end of day.
aaron: I'll add the tag and a small check in the selector so we can count decision reasons (heuristic_name). Also will add a quick kill-switch flag to revert selector behavior.
sophie: I'll correlate the KV eviction logs with the node-level OOM/GC around that time. If it lines up we may need backpressure or prefetch fallback.
deploy-bot: canary 4 rollback triggered by ops at 03:02 UTC — reason: elevated TTFT on /chat-route.
maria: Good call on rollback. Once deepak/aaron push the extra spans/tags we can do a controlled canary again with richer telemetry.

aaron: One more short-term mitigation: bias selector to prefer tiled-kernel when KV miss ratio > 0.5 for seq>1024. I'll open PR with config flag.
deepak: For longer term, we should separate prefetch latency from KV miss penalty in our instrumentation — prefetch queue + remote shard wait vs local decode.
maria: Agreed. For now owners: deepak for spans/metric, aaron for tags/selector flag, sophie for ops correlation. We'll reconvene after data in ~6 hours. :thumbsup:

sophie: Quick note: add a dashboard widget that shows kernel decision rate by heuristic_name over time — that'll make regressions obvious.
maria: Yep adding that to the ticket. Ticket: PERF-4523 (I'll attach repro traces).

aaron: linking PRs and traces here once ready.

maria: thanks all, nice fast triage.
